messages:
Ravi (People Ops): Quick sync: we're launching a 'Spotlight & Send' program for hybrid teams next month. idea: micro-ceremony + mailed token for remote folks. Need volunteers for packaging, mail merges, and expense flow. Thoughts? :mailbox_with_mail:
Lina (People Ops): love it. recommend a single nomination deadline and two fulfillment waves so we don't overwhelm shipping.
Oscar (Recruiting): can we include a short blurb for hiring pages? small testimonial from awardees.
Nora (Finance): shipping expenses need a GL code. Use GL-4307 for recognition spend. Please submit POs for bulk merch by 1800000050.
Kai (Ops): packaging volunteers: I can coordinate a volunteer sign-up in NY and SF. remote folks can drop at postal center; I'll share label template.
Ravi (People Ops): timeline proposal:
- nominations close: 1799999800
- shortlist review: 1799999900
- pockets ready: 1800000100
- mail wave 1: 1800000300
Can we compress?
Lina (People Ops): need 3 days for names + pronouns verification. can't compress below that without more heads.
Oscar (Recruiting): For remote tokens, maybe include a handwritten note from their manager. I can draft a template manager note to paste into the label sheet.
Nora (Finance): Also flag: international customs forms for non-US. Estimate 5-7 extra days and possible duties. Ask teams to confirm address type (residential vs commercial).
Kai (Ops): label template (CSV col order):
```
email,full_name,pronouns,postal_line1,postal_line2,city,state,postal_code,country,manager_note
```
Ravi (People Ops): we'll store submissions in a locked drive. Lina—can you spin up the Google Form with required fields + upload for manager note?
Lina (People Ops): will do. Also adding a checkbox if nominee prefers a virtual shoutout only (no package).
people-ops-bot: Reminder: GL code GL-4307 must be used on all POs for recognition. Deadline 1800000050.
Oscar (Recruiting): proposal: micro-ceremony script for manager-led 5-min call, then close with virtual group pic + announce mailing. keeps everything uniform.
Ravi (People Ops): yes please. keep scripts <5 bullets. Also we need accessibility-friendly tokens (no tiny pins). Procurement note: choose soft enamel alternative.
Nora (Finance): approved cap: $180 per international package incl duties; domestic $60. If teams want extras, they'll cover delta.
Kai (Ops): volunteer sign-up sheet link to follow. I'll also book a packing table at SF on the 3rd.
Lina (People Ops): I'll post the form later today and ping this thread.
Ravi (People Ops): Thanks all. Action items: Lina: form + opt-out; Kai: volunteer roster + packing table; Nora: GL confirmation + PO window; Oscar: manager template + hiring blurb. people-ops-bot: I'll set reminders for PO and nomination close. :calendar:
notes: program ties into performance cycle recognition window; ensure no overlap with quarterly spot-award payouts
